text: leo (PM): dropped a tiny prototype for a super-compact composer focused on streaming controls & token visibility: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/compact-stream-mini (see "micro state") maria (Design): main callouts: token badge is visually noisy at micro size and the action cluster feels cramped. proposing icon-only w/ tooltip + a thin divider. color swatches in fig comments. sam (Eng): perf note: exact tokenization every chunk is expensive. propose showing an approximate visual with a tilde ("~42") and swapping to exact on final chunk. estimator: ceil(char_count/4). telemetry flag when estimator used. jia (DevEx): accessibility: do not rely on hover. For sr/keyboard, aria-label should read "approximately 42 tokens" while the visual shows "~42". Add a hidden live region: `Streaming, approx 0 tokens`. Throttle updates to ~300ms. maria (Design): wording: "Stop" vs "Pause" vs "Interrupt". research leans to "Interrupt" for clarity but space is tight. if icon-only: visible tooltip + aria-label. I'll try both in the prototype. sam (Eng): keyboard mappings: Esc = interrupt, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = regenerate. Mobile: long-press on the bubble to reveal actions; show a one-time hint toast "Long-press to interrupt or regenerate". leo (PM): quick UX decision: use tilde visual + aria-label for SR, try "Interrupt" in tooltip copy. maria, add the two compact variants (label + icon-only). sam/jia, add aria snippet + hotkeys to the PR. maria (Design): will add spacing tweaks and contrast options (need >=4.5:1 for badge text). also adding a tiny separator between tokens and actions to avoid accidental taps. sam (Eng): dev note: when regenerate is triggered mid-stream, start a new req and crossfade responses to avoid jank; KV cache remains unless user clears. will implement smooth transition. jia (DevEx): SR nit: avoid announcing the tilde literally. aria-label should be "approximately 42 tokens". live region final message: "Generation complete final token count: 42". throttle rule again: >=250ms, aria-atomic=true. ux-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-mini/1719009999 please test keyboard, screen reader, and mobile long-press flows. leo (PM): timeline: target PR tomorrow afternoon. small checklist in PR description please: estimator enabled flag, aria snippets, keyboard handlers, mobile long-press hint. thanks! :thumbsup:
